purpose: Fresh-symbol independent replication of the frozen Q218 mandatory-versus-voluntary disclosure mechanism after the completed one-shot performance run.

universe.universe_rule: All eligible event pairs in the fixed observation window for these four fresh issuers; no outcome-based filtering or substitution.

event_pair_contract.pairing_rule: For each in-window 10-K, select the latest eligible Item 2.02 8-K by SEC acceptance timestamp in the reporting-cycle interval bounded below by the preceding 10-K acceptance and above/equal to the target 10-K acceptance.
event_pair_contract.amendment_rule: 10-K/A and 8-K/A are excluded from the eligible event population; parent/amendment lineage is independently checked as provenance.
event_pair_contract.acceptance_clock: SEC ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME raw 14-digit value, interpreted as America/New_York local wall-clock time; no implicit UTC.

feature_construction.document_scope: Primary document text from each exact paired filing only.
feature_construction.html_normalization: Decode entities; remove script/style nodes; collapse whitespace; preserve textual order.
feature_construction.topic_representation: Deterministic 64-bucket SHA-256 token hashing; bucket = first 8 hex digits modulo 64.

features.omission_asymmetry_by_topic: mean absolute difference of the 64 L1-normalized unigram-frequency buckets
features.secondary_framing_gap: 1 - cosine similarity of the 64 L1-normalized adjacent-token bigram-frequency buckets

outcome_contract.action_session: first XNYS trading session strictly after pair_closure_clock
outcome_contract.direction: signed two-sided; no ex-ante sign assumption
outcome_contract.price_source: Yahoo Finance daily chart quote OHLC from the repository-established historical source family.
outcome_contract.missingness: Missing action-session open/close is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; no imputation.
outcome_contract.corporate_actions: Raw source response is preserved; dividend cash flows are not modeled.
